summary: HiTek Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a 1-for-3 reverse stock split of its Class A ordinary shares, effective May 29, 2026, following a prior 1-for-50 split on April 6, 2026. The split reduces outstanding Class A shares from 2,324,420 to an expected 774,807, with Class B shares unchanged. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional amounts round up. The board approved the split within shareholder-authorised parameters, and the shares continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol HKIT. The filing is a routine corporate action to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation event.
